solutions.title: Hash by sorted key / count signature
solutions.notes: Group strings that scramble to the same key
solutions.time: O(n · k log k) sorted key
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Map each word to a canonical key (sorted chars or 26-count), then bucket words by that key.

**Example walkthrough:** "eat", "tea", "ate" all key to "aet" and land in one bucket; "tan"/"nat" share another.
